**STR** 8 (-1) | **DEX** 10 (+0) | **CON** 12 (+1) | **INT** 1 (-5) | **WIS** 7 (-2) | **CHA** 3 (-4)
**Damage Resistances:** fire
**Senses:** Blindsight 30 ft., Passive Perception 8
**Languages:** None

## Traits
